messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: About using DataFrame in SaprkR
parts:
+spark...@googlegroups.com

Hi Sailesh

The DataFrame API for SparkR is being developed in the sparkr-sql branch of the github repo (https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/tree/sparkr-sql). We don't yet have a user guide for this but the examples in the roxygen docs and the test cases (https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/sparkr-sql/pkg/inst/tests/test_sparkSQL.R) should give you a pointer on how to get started

Note that the DataFrame API is a work in progress, so we'd appreciate any feedback you have.

Thanks
Shivaram

On Fri, Mar 13, 2015 at 12:46 PM, Shailesh Raj <shaile...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Shivaram

I am using SparkR to run analytic application written in R on to Spark. I am able to run sample programs given ob SparkR console which is reading input stored on HDFS.
I want to use generate report like group by in SQL which is very simple in writing R using data.table. I wanted to use same R api but saprk returns RDD and DT needs DataFrame. For that some suggested to use DataFrame which is introduced in Spark 1.3. I recompiled SparkR with Spark 1.3. I executed following statement given on https://databricks.com/blog/2015/02/17/introducing-dataframes-in-spark-for-large-scale-data-science.html
logs = context.load("s3n://path/to/data.json", "json")

but R console is unable to recognize. I tried replacing context with SC but also didn't work

I guess SparkR is updated with DF in Spark 1.3? Please advise how to use R API which taked DF as input, with this I can really leverage potential of R



Regards
Shailesh

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: About using DataFrame in SaprkR
parts:
The installation instructions are

1. git clone https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg
2. cd SparkR-pkg
3. git checkout sparkr-sql
4. ./install-dev.sh

If you run into any problems with installing please post the error messages you get so we can see what the problem is

Thanks
Shivaram
